links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses on TBI compared with MSKTC patient fact sheets
links.effect: MSKTC fact sheets were significantly more reader-friendly than responses from both GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0; no strong correlation between reliability and readability.
links.quote: Readability comparisons found the MSKTC fact sheets were significantly more reader-friendly compared to responses from both artificial intelligence (AI) versions, with no strong correlation between reliability and readability.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0 responses for traumatic brain injury patient information against standard fact sheets, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
